page.overview:
Who is Julian Morrisey?

Julian Morrisey is a character that appears in (2018), (2021) and .

Julian is a young boy that Vicky would often babysit. He has a good relationship with the latter, and is one of the few people to survive the attack of Michael Myers. Julian is smart, knowing to avoid Michael during his encounter with him, by running out the house and telling Dave to do so as well. Julian likely ran to a neighbor's house, which got the police to the scene.

Julian makes a cameo in Halloween Kills. He is interviewed on the news after his escape from Michael and learning of Vicky's death. He remarks that she was his number one babysitter.

Julian, now around his early teens, appears again in Halloween Ends. He is a part of the procession after Michael Myers is finally killed at the hands of Laurie Strode. He then witnesses Michael being crushed in a grinder, putting an end to the terror that plagued Haddonfield.
